blocks.prompt: 5. The \(18^{\text{th}}\) term of a sequence is 367. The \(30^{\text{th}}\) term of the sequence is 499. How many terms of this sequence are less than 1000?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh A.P. wali exercise hai, is liye sequence ko A.P. maan kar chalenge. Humein do terms maloom hain: 18th aur 30th.
Find kya karna hai? Kitni terms 1000 se chhoti hain, yani ginti.
Plan: do terms se do equations, un se \(a_1\) aur \(d\); phir \(a_n < 1000\) wali inequality solve kar ke sab se bara whole number \(n\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_{18} = 367,\ a_{30} = 499\) (A.P.)
Humein find karna hai: kitni terms \(a_n < 1000\) hain.
Tareeqa: Dono terms ko \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) se likhenge, minus kar ke \(d\), phir \(a_1\). Agar \(d\) positive nikla to terms barhti jayengi, aur shuru ki kuch terms 1000 se neeche hongi, baqi oopar.

Do equations likhein
\[a_1 + 17d = 367 \quad (1)\]
\[a_1 + 29d = 499 \quad (2)\]
Kyun: 18th term tak 17 qadam, 30th term tak 29 qadam. Do unknowns (\(a_1\) aur \(d\)) hain aur do equations; is liye dono mil jayenge.

Minus kar ke \(d\), phir \(a_1\)
\[(2) - (1):\ 12d = 132\]
\[d = 11\]
\[a_1 = 367 - 17(11) = 367 - 187 = 180\]
Kyun: Dono equations mein \(a_1\) ek jaisa hai, minus karne se cancel ho jata hai aur sirf \(d\) bachta hai. Phir \(d = 11\) ko equation (1) mein wapas rakha.
Dhyan dein: \(29 - 17 = 12\) hai; yahan jaldi mein 13 likhna aam ghalti hai.

General term likhein
\[a_n = 180 + (n - 1)(11)\]
\[= 11n + 169\]
Kyun: Bracket khola: \(180 + 11n - 11 = 11n + 169\). Simple shakal mein inequality solve karna aasaan hoga.

Inequality solve karein
\[11n + 169 < 1000\]
\[11n < 831\]
\[n < 75.5\]
Kyun: Dono taraf se 169 minus kiya, phir 11 se divide (positive number se divide karne par inequality ka nishan nahi badalta). \(831 \div 11 = 75.54\ldots\). Lekin \(n\) term ki position hai, aadhi position nahi hoti, is liye sab se bara \(n\) 75 hai.

Tasdeeq: kinare wali terms
\[a_{75} = 11(75) + 169 = 994 < 1000\]
\[a_{76} = 1005 > 1000\]
Kyun: 75th term abhi 1000 se neeche hai aur 76th term 1000 se oopar chali gayi. \(d\) positive hai, to us ke baad wali sab terms bhi 1000 se bari hongi. Yani pehli 75 terms hi 1000 se chhoti hain.
